release_notes: ONE-LINER INSTALLER: /latest bootstrap (public/latest + scripts/latest.sh). Fresh install on a supported server is now: 'cd /home && curl -o latest -L https://planet-hosts.com/latest && sh latest'. The bootstrap auto-detects the OS (Debian/Ubuntu -> install_debian.sh; AlmaLinux/Rocky/CentOS/Fedora -> installer/install.sh; FreeBSD later), fetches VERSION.json from GitHub, downloads the official release tarball (kept on GitHub, NOT stored on the server), verifies its SHA-256 checksum, extracts it, and runs the correct installer. Verified live: https://planet-hosts.com/latest returns 200, and the full fetch -> checksum -> extract flow passes (134MB package, both installers + SHOUTcast binary present).
